record.paper_title: Open problems on countable dense homogeneity
record.original_question: For the product phenomena in which powers of a space alternate between countable dense homogeneous and non-countable dense homogeneous behavior, can any of the spaces witnessing these phenomena be chosen to be definable, for example analytic or co-analytic?

evidence.quote: Medini [58] also raises the question whether any of such spaces can be definable (e.g. analytic or co-analytic).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A separable topological space $X$ is said to be countable dense homogeneous (CDH) if for every pair $D, E$ of countable dense subsets of $X$ there is a homeomorphism $h\colon X\to X$ with $h(D)=E$. A subspace of a Polish space is called analytic if it is the continuous image of a Polish space, and co-analytic if its complement (in some/any ambient Polish space) is analytic.

Several known constructions exhibit "alternating" CDH behavior on powers: for instance, there exist separable metrizable spaces $X$ such that $X^n$ is CDH for some values of $n\in\mathbb{N}\cup\{\omega\}$ while $X^m$ fails to be CDH for other values of $m$ (e.g. $X$ CDH but $X^2$ not CDH, $X^2$ CDH but $X$ not, $X^\omega$ CDH but $X$ not Polish, etc.).

Question: Can any of the spaces witnessing such alternating CDH-versus-non-CDH behavior on their powers be chosen to be definable — in particular, analytic or co-analytic as a subspace of a Polish space?
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent work has produced definable witnesses in several cases. In particular, for co-analytic subspaces $X$ of $2^\omega$, $X^\omega$ being CDH is equivalent to $X$ being Polish, while analytic non-Polish examples $X\subseteq 2^\omega$ with $X^\omega$ CDH have been constructed in ZFC (via a Medvedev-type technique). Further results by Agostini–Medini–Zdomskyy give ZFC analytic/$\lambda$-set examples relevant to the group setting. However, definability of witnesses for every form of the alternating power phenomena does not appear to be fully settled.

status_evidence.title: Countable Dense Homogeneity in Powers of Zero-dimensional Definable Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: For a coanalytic subspace X of 2^ω, X^ω CDH is equivalent to X Polish; an analytic non-Polish X with X^ω CDH is constructed in ZFC.
status_evidence.claim: Partial definable-witness results known for the X vs X^ω phenomenon.

status_evidence.title: Countable dense homogeneity and topological groups
status_evidence.snippet: ZFC example of a non-Polish CDH topological group as a dense λ-subgroup of Z^ω.
status_evidence.claim: Definable (analytic-like) witnesses in further CDH phenomena have been constructed.
